intent.statement: Migrate the legacy PHP CRM to TypeScript while preserving the CSV import workflow and a migration batch budget.
intent.normalized: legacy crm migration: preserve csv import, batch time budget

glossary.definition: One row of the legacy CRM customer table including its notes.
The daily operator workflow that loads contacts from a CSV file.

assumptions.statement: The legacy CRM stays online until the migration cutover completes.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A dual-write phase would be needed before any cutover.

requirements.statement: The system shall migrate every **Customer Record** from the legacy CRM without data loss.
The system shall keep **CSV Import** behavior byte-compatible with the legacy importer.
NFR: a migration batch of ten thousand records must finish within five minutes.

decisions.decision: Rewrite the importer in TypeScript and diff its outputs against the legacy importer.
decisions.rationale: A byte-level differential harness is the only trustworthy oracle for the parsing quirks operators rely on.

alternatives.option: Keep the PHP importer as a sidecar
alternatives.rejected_because: Two runtimes would double the ops surface.

tasks.title: Customer record migration
tasks.purpose: Move every customer record from the legacy database without loss.
preconditions: Read replica of the legacy database available
invariants: Migration writes are idempotent per customer id
tasks.instructions: Implement the batch reader and writer inside src/migration; never mutate legacy rows.

cases: REQ-0001: migrated record counts match the legacy export

acceptance: Row counts and checksums match the export
tasks.rollback: Revert the migration commit; the legacy system is untouched.

tasks.title: CSV import port
tasks.purpose: Port the CSV importer byte-compatibly and hold the batch budget.
invariants: Importer output stays byte-identical to the legacy importer on the reference corpus
tasks.instructions: Port the parser inside src/import and run the differential harness against the legacy outputs.

cases: REQ-0002: imported rows match the legacy importer byte for byte
OPS-0001: a ten-thousand-row batch finishes within five minutes

acceptance: Differential harness green and budget held

legacy.as_is_summary: A PHP monolith CRM of roughly forty thousand lines with MySQL storage and a CSV contact importer used daily by operators.

preserve_change_drop.rationale: The daily operator workflow depends on the exact parsing quirks of the legacy importer.
